candidate: caller supplies validator_id + claimed validator_sha256 + independent callable
counterexample: Initialize a ledger with the correct bridge-v2 validator_id and correct claimed bridge-v2 SHA-256, then reopen using the same validator_id and same claimed SHA-256 but the bridge-v1 callable. The sidecar comparison succeeds because it authenticates caller claims rather than callable bytes, and a one-capture receipt can issue under the supposedly v2-pinned ledger.
consequence: Do not retain ID+claimed-hash+callable as a validator contract. The successor must compute the hash internally from source bytes and load the callable from those exact bytes.
